title: Trace one on independently transported scalar Chern adjuncts
statement: Let l be prime, Y,P=P1_Y,W=P×Y P Noetherian schemes with DiagonalTraceLocalizations, and l a global unit on Y. Let family and Reference r be as in def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference, and a,b the completed Chern adjuncts for r.tq and r.t2 satisfying the whole-system normalization of def-sfb-rational-p1-scalar-chern-maps. At any finite rational or closure coefficient c, scalarQChern(a) followed by the actual q trace is the identity of the degree-zero coefficient unit on Y; independently, scalarP2Chern(b) followed by the actual p2 trace is the identity of that unit on P. No geometric exchange or base-change hypothesis is used.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_chern_degree
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (r : Reference l Y δ family)
    (a : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      r.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (ha : CompletedChernNormalized l r.tq.toPresentation a)
    (b : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l (ProjectiveLine Y) ⟶
      r.t₂.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (diagonalSurface Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (hb : CompletedChernNormalized l r.t₂.toPresentation b) :
    let Λ := (coefficient l c).X
    let d := diagram l c Y family
    scalarQChern l c Y r a ≫ trace Λ Y (line l c) d = 𝟙 _ ∧
      scalarP2Chern l c Y r b ≫
        (secondDiagramPushIso Λ Y (line l c) d).inv.app
          (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
            (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≫ d.trace₂ = 𝟙 _
